title: French Beef Stew
description: A hearty French stew made with tender beef, vegetables, and a rich red wine broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion, carrot, and celery until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaves. Stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Strain the broth and discard the solids. Serve the beef and vegetables in the rich broth.
